why: GEAR POLICY. 'keep' = items the tool never advises selling/listing because you will use or need to replace them. Each entry: item (exact name), qty (how many to keep), upgrade (optional better item: when you can afford it, `next` says SELL the old and BUY the upgrade). auto_keep_fitted = also keep spares of whatever is fitted on your active ship (replacement after a loss). Remote buying: place a BUY order at the station you want it delivered to (Marketing/Procurement skills set the range) and leave it stowed in that station's hangar until needed - check in game, the tool cannot place orders.
gear_notes: Mining turrets: the best dedicated mining ships fit at most 3 turrets (Venture 2). 3 x Miner I covers any of them, so lower-grade Civilian Miners are surplus and may be sold (verify hardpoints in the in-game fitting window).
